change_summary: Make headless asynchronous completion and canonical reuse readback executable boundaries instead of implicit follow-up assumptions.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.9 makes terminal polling and current Project plus reader readback explicit without prescribing a case, title, tree, or tool recipe.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; the server advertises Skill and Plugin 1.7.9 without widening authority or changing MCP schemas.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.9 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.9.

package_setup.note: The existing bounded session hook remains compatible; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 matrix remains unchanged; repeated cross-case Claude evidence promotes only the generic terminal-polling and canonical-readback boundary.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill and package identity, headless terminal completion wording, canonical reuse readback, and the unchanged host-neutral matrix contract.
